completedReport.scope: Experimental nominal-rate direct USB fixture transport; missing-feedback clocking remains unvalidated. No end-to-end bit-perfect claim.
completedReport.signalPattern: 0-2s left 440 Hz; 2-3s silence; 3-5s right 440 Hz; 5-6s silence. Repeats; no both-channel section.

streamExperiment.clocking: Experimental nominal 1000-interval/s packet cadence; no feedback or capture timing. Device clocking remains unvalidated.

native.errnoNote: errnoAfterCall is supplementary; libusb return codes are authoritative. Positive kernel-driver results mean active, not a transfer byte count.

unavailableMeasurements: DAC render clock and internal DSP

interpretation: A newer checkpoint without a matching final report is incomplete evidence, not proof of a battery kill. Exit records may be absent or unrelated; compare timestamps and process IDs. Installing an update may itself add an exit record. No automatic restart.
